结果已经明确了一半：

CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_LOG_LEVEL：当前 Kconfig 整段缺失，upstream 有完整配置，因此 .config 无法生成该值。
sys_startup_fn()：两个 esp_start.c 完全相同；但当前版本缺少 upstream 中声明该函数的 esp_start.h，所以出现隐式声明。

还需确认 Kconfig 插入位置，以及 upstream 如何包含 esp_start.h。执行下面的只读命令：

cd ~/openvela-work/contest284/nuttx

echo "=== 当前 Kconfig 330-430 ==="
sed -n '330,430p' \
  arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/Kconfig

echo "=== upstream Kconfig 330-430 ==="
sed -n '330,430p' \
  ~/openvela-work/upstream/nuttx/arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/Kconfig

echo "=== Kconfig 局部差异 ==="
diff -u \
  <(sed -n '320,440p' arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/Kconfig) \
  <(sed -n '320,440p' ~/openvela-work/upstream/nuttx/arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/Kconfig) \
  | sed -n '1,260p'

echo "=== esp_start.c 文件头 ==="
sed -n '20,70p' \
  arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/esp_start.c

echo "=== upstream esp_start.c 文件头 ==="
sed -n '20,70p' \
  ~/openvela-work/upstream/nuttx/arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/esp_start.c

echo "=== esp_start.h 是否存在 ==="
ls -l \
  arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/esp_start.h \
  ~/openvela-work/upstream/nuttx/arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/esp_start.h \
  2>&1

echo "=== 谁包含 esp_start.h ==="
grep -Rns --include='*.c' --include='*.h' --include='Make.defs' \
  'esp_start.h' \
  arch/risc-v/src \
  ~/openvela-work/upstream/nuttx/arch/risc-v/src 2>/dev/null \
  | sed -n '1,100p'

暂时不要直接在 .config 里写：

CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_LOG_LEVEL=0

因为它会在重新配置时丢失。正确做法应是恢复 upstream 的 Kconfig 配置块，让 olddefconfig 自动生成；sys_startup_fn() 也优先恢复 upstream 的正式头文件声明，而不是随手在 .c 中增加声明。

文档
思考了 25s

现在可以确认：

esp_start.c 已正确包含 esp_start.h。
当前 esp_start.h 是旧版本，缺少 sys_startup_fn() 声明。
CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_LOG_LEVEL 整个配置块确实没有进入当前 Kconfig。
当前和 upstream 的 Kconfig 排列差异很大，不能直接按 upstream 行号复制，否则可能再次破坏菜单结构。

再做最后一次只读定位：

cd ~/openvela-work/contest284/nuttx

echo "=== esp_start.h 完整差异 ==="
diff -u \
  arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/esp_start.h \
  ~/openvela-work/upstream/nuttx/arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/esp_start.h \
  | sed -n '1,240p'

echo "=== 当前 Kconfig 菜单结构及关键配置 ==="
grep -nE \
  '^menu |^endmenu|^config ESPRESSIF_(SIMPLE_BOOT|BOOTLOADER|CPU_FREQ|MAX_CPU_FREQ|MIN_CPU_FREQ|LOG_LEVEL)' \
  arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/Kconfig \
  | sed -n '1,260p'

echo "=== upstream Kconfig 菜单结构及关键配置 ==="
grep -nE \
  '^menu |^endmenu|^config ESPRESSIF_(SIMPLE_BOOT|BOOTLOADER|CPU_FREQ|MAX_CPU_FREQ|MIN_CPU_FREQ|LOG_LEVEL)' \
  ~/openvela-work/upstream/nuttx/arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/Kconfig \
  | sed -n '1,260p'

echo "=== 当前 SIMPLE_BOOT 附近 ==="
grep -n -B15 -A30 \
  '^config ESPRESSIF_SIMPLE_BOOT' \
  arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/Kconfig

echo "=== 当前第一个外设配置前后 ==="
grep -n -B12 -A12 \
  '^config ESPRESSIF_TWAI0' \
  arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/Kconfig

完成这一步后，修复应当是：

从 upstream 精确移植 esp_start.h 中缺少的函数声明；
将官方 Espressif Log Level 配置块插入当前 Kconfig 的正确菜单边界；
执行 make olddefconfig，由 Kconfig 自动生成 CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_LOG_LEVEL=0；
再清理编译。

不会直接硬编码 .config，也不会整份覆盖当前 openvela 的 Kconfig。

粘贴的文本 (1)(20260809-051756).txt
文档
思考了 1m 9s

现在证据充分，可以做两个精确移植：

esp_start.h 与 upstream 只有 SPDX 和 sys_startup_fn() 声明不同，因此可直接同步该头文件。
Log Level 配置块应插在当前 Bootloader and Image Configuration 菜单之前，位置与 upstream 一致。

先同步头文件：

cd ~/openvela-work/contest284/nuttx

cp \
  ~/openvela-work/upstream/nuttx/arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/esp_start.h \
  arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/esp_start.h

再提取并插入 upstream 的官方 Log Level 配置块：

P4_LOG_BLOCK=/tmp/esp32p4_log_level.kconfig

sed -n \
  '/^menu "Espressif Log Level"$/,/^endmenu # Espressif Log Level$/p' \
  ~/openvela-work/upstream/nuttx/arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/Kconfig \
  > "$P4_LOG_BLOCK"

wc -l "$P4_LOG_BLOCK"

P4_BOOT_LINE=$(grep -n \
  '^menu "Bootloader and Image Configuration"$' \
  arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/Kconfig \
  | head -1 | cut -d: -f1)

echo "Bootloader menu line: $P4_BOOT_LINE"

sed -i \
  "$((P4_BOOT_LINE - 1))r $P4_LOG_BLOCK" \
  arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/Kconfig

确认没有重复插入：

grep -c '^menu "Espressif Log Level"$' \
  arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/Kconfig

grep -c '^config ESPRESSIF_LOG_LEVEL$' \
  arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/Kconfig

grep -n -B3 -A5 '^config ESPRESSIF_LOG_LEVEL$' \
  arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/Kconfig

git diff --check

前两个计数都必须为 1。

然后让 Kconfig 自动生成配置：

make olddefconfig

验证：

grep -E \
  '^CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_LOG_LEVEL(_NONE)?=' \
  .config

grep -E \
  '^#define CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_LOG_LEVEL(_NONE)? ' \
  include/nuttx/config.h

L0 无调试日志配置下，预计得到：

CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_LOG_LEVEL_NONE=y
CONFIG_ESPRESSIF_LOG_LEVEL=0

最后重新构建：

make clean

make -j2 2>&1 \
  | tee ~/openvela-work/logs/contest284_esp32p4_build11.log

暂时不要 git add。先确认这两个错误都越过，再处理下一处真正的兼容问题。

   203	  intr_handler_t handler;
   204	  struct intr_adapter_from_nuttx *handler_arg;
   205	
   206	  /* Validate cpuint - if invalid, the interrupt was not properly
   207	   * registered via esp_setup_irq. This is a bug that needs to be fixed.
   208	   */
   209	
   210	  if (cpuint < 0 || cpuint >= SOC_CPU_INTR_NUM)
   211	    {

   217	  handler_arg = (struct intr_adapter_from_nuttx *)

   222	   * esp_setup_irq. Exceptions are the interrupts set directly by the
   223	   * underlying hardware, like Wi-Fi.

   226	  if (handler == &isr_adapter_func)
   227	    {
   228	      handler_arg->irq = irq;
   229	      handler_arg->context = context;
   230	    }
   231	
   232	  if (handler)

#############################################################################
# Espressif HAL for 3rd Party Platforms
#############################################################################

# Fetch source files and add them to build

ESP_HAL_3RDPARTY_REPO   = esp-hal-3rdparty
ifndef ESP_HAL_3RDPARTY_VERSION
	ESP_HAL_3RDPARTY_VERSION = 8d0a898910084206721a0892ab093021bca1496a
endif

ifndef ESP_HAL_3RDPARTY_URL
	ESP_HAL_3RDPARTY_URL = https://github.com/espressif/esp-hal-3rdparty.git
endif

ifndef DISABLE_GIT_DEPTH
ifndef GIT_DEPTH
	GIT_DEPTH=1
endif
	GIT_DEPTH_PARAMETER = --depth=$(GIT_DEPTH)
endif

# When set USE_NXTMPDIR_ESP_REPO_DIRECTLY=y, will directly use esp-hal-3rdparty
# under nxtmpdir without CHECK_COMMITSHA, reset, checkout and update.

USE_NXTMPDIR_ESP_REPO_DIRECTLY ?= n

ifeq ($(STORAGETMP),y)
ifeq ($(USE_NXTMPDIR_ESP_REPO_DIRECTLY),y)
define CLONE_ESP_HAL_3RDPARTY_REPO
	$(call COPYDIR, $(NXTMPDIR)/$(ESP_HAL_3RDPARTY_REPO),chip/$(ESP_HAL_3RDPARTY_REPO))
endef
else
define CLONE_ESP_HAL_3RDPARTY_REPO
	$(call CHECK_COMMITSHA, $(NXTMPDIR)/$(ESP_HAL_3RDPARTY_REPO),$(ESP_HAL_3RDPARTY_VERSION))
	$(call CLONE, $(ESP_HAL_3RDPARTY_URL),chip/$(ESP_HAL_3RDPARTY_REPO),$(NXTMPDIR)/$(ESP_HAL_3RDPARTY_REPO))
endef
endif
else
define CLONE_ESP_HAL_3RDPARTY_REPO
	$(call CLONE, $(ESP_HAL_3RDPARTY_URL),chip/$(ESP_HAL_3RDPARTY_REPO))
endef
endif

chip/$(ESP_HAL_3RDPARTY_REPO):
	$(Q) echo "Cloning Espressif HAL for 3rd Party Platforms"
	$(Q) $(call CLONE_ESP_HAL_3RDPARTY_REPO)
ifneq ($(USE_NXTMPDIR_ESP_REPO_DIRECTLY),y)
	$(Q) echo "Espressif HAL for 3rd Party Platforms: ${ESP_HAL_3RDPARTY_VERSION}"
	$(Q) git -C chip/$(ESP_HAL_3RDPARTY_REPO) checkout --quiet $(ESP_HAL_3RDPARTY_VERSION)
endif
ifeq ($(CONFIG_ESP_WIRELESS),y)
ifneq ($(USE_NXTMPDIR_ESP_REPO_DIRECTLY),y)
	$(Q) echo "Espressif HAL for 3rd Party Platforms: initializing submodules..."
	$(Q) git -C chip/$(ESP_HAL_3RDPARTY_REPO) submodule --quiet update --init $(GIT_DEPTH_PARAMETER) components/mbedtls/mbedtls components/esp_phy/lib components/esp_wifi/lib components/bt/controller/lib_esp32c3_family components/esp_coex/lib
	$(Q) git -C chip/$(ESP_HAL_3RDPARTY_REPO)/components/mbedtls/mbedtls reset --quiet --hard
endif
	$(Q) echo "Applying patches..."
	$(Q) cd chip/$(ESP_HAL_3RDPARTY_REPO)/components/mbedtls/mbedtls && git apply ../../../nuttx/patches/components/mbedtls/mbedtls/*.patch
endif

include common$(DELIM)espressif$(DELIM)Bootloader.mk

+/**
+  * @brief Enable interrupts from interrupt controller.
+  *
+  * @param uint32_t unmask, unmask bits for interrupts, each bit for an interrupt
+  *
+  * return none
+  */
+void esprv_intc_int_enable(uint32_t unmask) __attribute__((deprecated("please use esprv_int_enable instead")));
+
+/**
+  * @brief Disable interrupts from interrupt controller.
+  *
+  * @param uint32_t mask, mask bits for interrupts, each bit for an interrupt
+  *
+  * return none
+  */
+void esprv_intc_int_disable(uint32_t mask) __attribute__((deprecated("please use esprv_int_disable instead")));
+
+/**
+ * @brief Set interrupt type
+ *
+ * Set the type of a particular interrupt (level or edge).
+ * - Level interrupts are cleared automatically once their interrupt source has
+ *   been cleared
+ * - Edge interrupts must be cleared by software when they are handled.
+ *
+ * @param intr_num Interrupt number
+ * @param type Interrupt type
+ */
+void esprv_intc_int_set_type(int intr_num, enum intr_type type) __attribute__((deprecated("please use esprv_int_set_type instead")));
+
+/**
+ * @brief Get the current type of an interrupt
+ *
+ * Get the current type of a particular interrupt (level or edge). An interrupt's
+ * type can be set by calling esprv_intc_int_set_type().
+ *
+ * @param intr_num Interrupt number
+ * @return Interrupt type
+ */
+static inline __attribute__((deprecated("please use esprv_int_get_type instead"))) enum intr_type esprv_intc_int_get_type(int intr_num)
+{
+    return esprv_int_get_type(intr_num);
+}
+
+/**
+ * Set interrupt priority in the interrupt controller
+ * @param rv_int_num CPU interrupt number
+ * @param priority Interrupt priority level, 1 to 7
+ */
+void esprv_intc_int_set_priority(int rv_int_num, int priority) __attribute__((deprecated("please use esprv_int_set_priority instead")));
+
+/**
+ * @brief Get the current priority of an interrupt
+ *
+ * Get the current priority of an interrupt.
+ *
+ * @param rv_int_num CPU interrupt number
+ * @return Interrupt priority level, 1 to 7
+ */
+static inline __attribute__((deprecated("please use esprv_int_get_priority instead"))) int esprv_intc_int_get_priority(int rv_int_num)
+{
+    return esprv_int_get_priority(rv_int_num);

+
+/**
+ * Set interrupt priority threshold.

+ *
+ * @param priority_threshold  Interrupt priority threshold, 0 to 7
+ */

+

+}

    arch/risc-v/espressif: Update common-source integration for RISC-V devices
    
    This commit updates the common-source integration for RISC-V-based
    Espressif devices (ESP32-C3, ESP32-C6, and ESP32-H2). This is part of a
    larger common-source update split by architecture for better maintainability
    of the already-supported devices and upcoming devices.
    
    Major components updated:
    - IRQ allocator refactoring with intr_alloc integration
    - Common-source drivers (GPIO, RMT, I2C, SPI, UART, etc.)
    - Espressif components upgrade to release/master.b
    - Peripheral drivers (ADC, PWM, LEDC, MCPWM, PCNT, Temperature Sensor, etc.)
    - Wireless adapters (Wi-Fi and BLE)
    - Board defconfigs for all RISC-V Espressif boards
    - Critical section handling improvements
    
    Key architectural changes:
    - IRQ Allocator: The new interrupt allocator enables multiple mapping
      options from interrupt sources to CPU interrupts, providing flexibility
      required by modern peripherals. Although this introduces breaking changes
      to the interrupt handling API, the required ARCH_MINIMAL_VECTORTABLE
      Kconfig option is explicitly checked during startup to ensure proper
      configuration. This validation prevents runtime issues from configuration
      mismatches.
    
    Note: This is a large commit to maintain bisectability. Breaking the
    changes into smaller commits would result in non-building intermediate
    states across the common-source infrastructure update.
    
    Tested configurations:
    - All defconfigs were built and tested, inclusing `ostest`.
    
    Signed-off-by: Tiago Medicci Serrano <tiago.medicci@espressif.com>

    arch/risc-v/espressif: Update common-source integration for RISC-V devices
    
    This commit updates the common-source integration for RISC-V-based
    Espressif devices (ESP32-C3, ESP32-C6, and ESP32-H2). This is part of a
    larger common-source update split by architecture for better maintainability
    of the already-supported devices and upcoming devices.
    
    Major components updated:
    - IRQ allocator refactoring with intr_alloc integration
    - Common-source drivers (GPIO, RMT, I2C, SPI, UART, etc.)
    - Espressif components upgrade to release/master.b
    - Peripheral drivers (ADC, PWM, LEDC, MCPWM, PCNT, Temperature Sensor, etc.)
    - Wireless adapters (Wi-Fi and BLE)
    - Board defconfigs for all RISC-V Espressif boards
    - Critical section handling improvements
    
    Key architectural changes:
    - IRQ Allocator: The new interrupt allocator enables multiple mapping
      options from interrupt sources to CPU interrupts, providing flexibility
      required by modern peripherals. Although this introduces breaking changes
      to the interrupt handling API, the required ARCH_MINIMAL_VECTORTABLE
      Kconfig option is explicitly checked during startup to ensure proper
      configuration. This validation prevents runtime issues from configuration
      mismatches.
    
    Note: This is a large commit to maintain bisectability. Breaking the
    changes into smaller commits would result in non-building intermediate
    states across the common-source infrastructure update.
    
    Tested configurations:
    - All defconfigs were built and tested, inclusing `ostest`.
    
    Signed-off-by: Tiago Medicci Serrano <tiago.medicci@espressif.com>
    
    To be merged with RISC-V implementation
